verdict.rationale: Unreal provides in-editor Play-In-Editor testing (unreal-docs-9), command-line test flags (unreal-docs-32), and the Unreal Automation Tool for automated testing/building (unreal-docs-30) that let developers iterate without touching a shipped/production build, which loosely maps to a 'sandbox' workflow. However there is no explicit documentation framing this as an isolated sandbox distinct from live production data (e.g., no mention of test databases, staging servers, or data isolation for multiplayer/replication scenarios). Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging environment docs separate from production servers, evidence of data isolation guarantees, and any AI-agent-specific sandbox tooling.
